subject: Stratus Labs — order form redlines: output ownership & training
body:
From: Sasha Kline <sasha.kline@stratuslabs.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: j.wong@stratuslabs.com, eric.lee@stratuslegal.com
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form redlines — output ownership & training

Hi Olga,

Attaching our redlines to the Order Form (Stratus_OrderForm_redlines_v2.docx) — main asks:
- We need explicit confirmation that Stratus Labs owns all outputs generated from our data (including derivatives).
- We require an opt-out from any use of our content to further train Redwood models (no training on customer data by default).
- Narrow "feedback" license: telemetry/metrics only for diagnostics and only aggregated/anonymized.

Can your team confirm whether these points are acceptable and whether you can provide proposed language? Our legal (Eric) copied here; happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sasha Kline
Head of Platform, Stratus Labs
Attachment: Stratus_OrderForm_redlines_v2.docx

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Kline <sasha.kline@stratuslabs.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines — output ownership & training

Hi Sasha — thanks for the redlines and the clear bullets. Looping in Legal (Rishi), Contracts (Laura) and Sales (Ben) to get a consolidated response.

Quick context from our side: we aim to be explicit on output attribution while preserving the ability to improve our models via opt-in feedback/telemetry paths for customers who choose it. We can propose precise carveouts to address Stratus's data and derivative concerns. Will come back with suggested language by EOD Friday.

Olga
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Order form redlines — output ownership & training

Folks — first pass thoughts for negotiation:

1) Output ownership:
- Accept customer ownership of outputs and derivatives that are directly generated from their input (proposed clause: "Customer retains all right, title and interest in Outputs generated by the Service from Customer Content, excluding model weights and improvements created independently by Redwood").

2) Training / model retraining:
- Offer explicit opt-in for training: customers may choose to allow Redwood to use their data to improve models; default = no training. Add an agreed-on "opt-in" toggle via the Console and require written authorization for any shipment of raw customer data into training pipelines.
- For aggregated telemetry/metrics used for general improvements, propose language: "Redwood may use aggregated and de-identified Telemetry solely for service reliability and performance improvements; such Telemetry will not include Customer Content or Outputs."

3) Feedback license (narrow):
- Make the Feedback license limited, time-boxed, and for limited purposes (bug fixes, service improvements). Consider an escape hatch for security/abuse signaling that allows temporary retention for investigation.

I drafted a short redline (redline_proposal_olga_20280324.docx) with the exact wording above — attached. Two decision points that will affect commercial terms: training opt-in granularity (one-click via Console vs contract-level) and treatment of aggregated telemetry (Stratus may still want opt-out if they consider telemetry sensitive).

Rishi
Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redline_proposal_olga_20280324.docx

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Mar 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Order form redlines — output ownership & training

Agree with Rishi's approach. A couple of practical notes for the Ops/implementation side to avoid surprises:
- Telemetry carveout: limit to aggregated/rolling metrics (no token-level traces); allow customers to request a telemetry export to verify aggregation if needed.
- Logging/Audit: add an audit log clause that records opt-in/opt-out changes and any dataset ingest actions — helps with compliance requests.
- Security questionnaire (attached Stratus_SecQuestionnaire.pdf) indicated some encryption/KMS asks — these shouldn't affect the redline language but may affect scope of Private deployment options.

I'll insert the telemetry and audit lines into Rishi's draft.

Laura
Director, Contracts & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Stratus_SecQuestionnaire.pdf

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Order form redlines — output ownership & training

One commercial point: if we accept default "no training" and make training opt-in only, pricing should reflect that limited model improvement pipeline for Stratus (they won't be contributing to general model quality). Recommend we flag to Sasha that optional training has a modest credit/discount trade (e.g., 10% credit against usage for customers who opt in).

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Kline <sasha.kline@stratuslabs.com>, Jennifer Wong <j.wong@stratuslabs.com>, Eric Lee <eric.lee@stratuslegal.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form redlines — output ownership & training

Hi Sasha / Jennifer / Eric — thanks for the patience while we reviewed. Attached is our consolidated redline (redline_proposal_olga_20280324.docx) with the following commitments:

- Customer ownership: we accept that Stratus Labs retains rights in Outputs generated from Customer Content (language included).
- Training: default = no training on Customer Content. If Stratus opts in, we will require explicit authorization via contract or the Console toggle and will document the scope of any dataset access.
- Feedback/Telemetry: Redwood may use aggregated and de-identified telemetry for reliability and performance improvements only; no customer Outputs or raw Customer Content will be used in model training unless the customer has opted in.
- Audit & Controls: audit logs will record opt-in changes and any data ingest for model improvement; for customers requiring stronger isolation we have Private deployment options and KMS integrations.

Next steps: please review the attached redline and confirm acceptance or propose targeted edits by EOD Thu (31 Mar). If acceptable, we'll push the updated Order Form into DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC123DEF.

If you'd prefer a 30-min call to walk the language, I'm available Wed/Thu afternoon PST.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redline_proposal_olga_20280324.docx
